# Economic network: actual source witnesses and executable diagnostic

The accepted research, relationship inspector and pure reader remain intact. The incumbent source producer, immutable intake and generation-pinned reader have now completed two real convenience witnesses: a complete-empty MU response and a complete-nonempty NVIDIA response. Both include actual repeated intake of the same acquired artifact and public independent review. They are separate requests with different query ranges; they do not constitute a vendor comparison or a selected research cohort.

Start with [execution status 008](EXECUTION_STATUS_20261009_008.md), the [NVIDIA evidence guide](native_nvda_execution_008/README.md) and the [unchanged independent public-result review](native_nvda_execution_008/INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW_001.md). The [issuer-coordinate note](native_nvda_execution_008/ISSUER_COORDINATES_AND_LIMITS_006.md) distinguishes public issuer facts from the vendor field whose date semantics remain unreconciled.

The [corrected structural diagnostic kernel](source_diagnostic_kernel_v1/README.md) preserves its 117 passing native cases, original failure and corrective evidence, independent public API/output-bound review and existing CI enrollment. Its [36-file source map](KERNEL_SOURCE_MAP_004.json) remains unchanged. This checkpoint saves source execution evidence and alters no producer, kernel, shared CI manifest, curated test inventory, source registry or product authority.

The observation carrier [PR8711](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/pull/8711) is currently published at 964a4b36dddff4e2b01eea4e8e8b2d69dfb4b031. Its naturally triggered run 37962235329 and ordinary release are separate from the source captures. Later dated receipts govern their eventual outcome. The kernel carrier will normally integrate accepted observation source before its own hosted release.

The complete [previous source checkpoint](EXECUTION_STATUS_20261009_006.md) and [previous root index](native_nvda_execution_008/README_BEFORE_NVDA_PUBLICATION_007.md) retain their exact bytes and freeze-time statements. The [accepted implementation masterplan](../../economic_network_20261008/IMPLEMENTATION_MASTERPLAN.md) remains the build sequence; these source results advance its evidence without asserting commissioning Sol CEO architectural adjudication.

Individual source acquisition F is observed. Global WP02 cohort F remains null, selected cohort count is zero, and the 42 complete ranking pools and thirty genuine difficult cases remain unacquired. Sources retain context/display authority, zero proposal weight, false basis eligibility and false action capabilities. Graph1 remains null. Share-action evidence supports equity-basis investigation; commercial economic edges still require separate evidence of roles, products, counterparties and temporal scope.

The original named handoff attachment remains unrecovered. The full visible commission has been researched; attachment-specific conformity and production or predictive acceptance are not asserted.

# Execution status 008: nonempty source witness and release continuation

Date: 2026-10-09. Existing operation: gmi-economic-source-diagnostic-20261009-pro-004. Actual capture execution head: 74c542beb6e137958e3babe91a78b50aef651768. A later evidence publication commit does not rewrite that source identity.

The new request used the same reviewed source owner and existing entitlement. It acquired once into a fresh private store, retained a complete normalized artifact, read the exact returned generation and repeated intake of the same acquisition without reacquisition. The source code and store preservation checks are recorded rather than inferred from successful exit alone.

These are one producer's page and acquisition records, not independent packet-level network instrumentation. The source producer did not retain raw HTTP response bodies. Public artifacts contain body hash/length metadata and source/receipt references; normalized private rows, row identifiers, provider dates/ratios/classifications and private runtime/store payloads are not exported.

The earlier MU result remains independently frozen and published in checkpoint 006: one complete-empty response for its own lower-bound query, one actual acquisition, an unchanged repeated intake and pinned read. The two different query ranges prevent a performance or vendor-coverage comparison.

## Independent review and its exact boundary

The public-only verifier, PID 66845, completed exit 0 in 0.21 s. Its 2,561 source, identity, structural and temporal assertions are evidence-verification checks, not 2,561 application tests. It directly hashed 35 permitted repository paths totaling 1,130,531 bytes, checked the 18 source pins and 21 before/after import identities, and retained the full input inventory. The source-path sets overlap; their counts must not be added as distinct files.

It independently reproduced the canonical public owner receipt, owner receipt content ID, capture/vintage/revision identities, read seal, expected metadata-only child stdout and integer-nanosecond ordering. The full immutable review is preserved unchanged in INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW_001.md, with its verifier/result/original manifest inside the public evidence archive. Its external process-completion receipt is separate from the report's pre-terminal snapshot.

The principal's public result reports a nonempty result, requested token binding and consistency with the predeclared issuer profile. That predicate actually ran on retained private rows in the reviewed action. The public reviewer verified its code and boolean binding, but did not read the row or independently recompute the private predicate. This limitation is retained. The public artifact hash is a reference; the nonempty artifact and acquisition seal were not independently reconstructed from withheld rows.

Vendor execution-date semantics remain UNRECONCILED. Public issuer announcement, record, legal-effective, distribution and expected-trading coordinates are distinct. The linked issuer note supplies primary sources and keeps those distinctions. No observed first market trade is claimed.

## Exact source and recovery preservation

The actual action is 19,659 bytes, SHA-256 264535ec562043a18e4bc75c92fbbe9b5cba12428422b2a9677e89c0f769f699. The actual bootstrap is 29,119 bytes, SHA-256 92298f53a839bea81b16556ff71277f461d44f732df88a044a990785c620f0a3. The retained launch payload is 31,167 bytes, SHA-256 c1745bbce8934986ad0a218818b2f435121ed405d48a7ed1200a92272337e221.

The first NVDA preparation was not executed. Its independent review corrected initial comparison status and conditional limitation prose before the actual source call. The earlier locally frozen pre-execution/source-profile package remains referenced by its original hashes; inaccessible local originals are not claimed as newly recovered or included.

The scratch executor later stalled. The principal's FINDINGS write in orchestration cell635 and the reviewer's input-manifest preparation in cell208 have unknown local file effects. Only their orchestration waits were terminated; no native provider or Git process was signalled and no unknown write was replayed. A separate authorized native public review completed successfully. Its report preserves the change of carrier. Current new publication files have distinct paths.

The principal's original launch/start/completion objects have since been recovered from exact session-store values through a verified unreferenced Git-blob transport. Their JSON is exact value serialization, not claimed network wire bytes or newly reread scratch files. The independent review's narrower original shell-payload attribution is unchanged. New publication does not relabel the unknown local saves as successful.

A fresh principal preflight at 74c verified all 151 members of NATIVE_SOURCE_PUBLICATION_MANIFEST_007.json, all 149 files then inside the checkpoint, the unchanged 36-file kernel delivery map and the 35 source/four public inputs used by the native independent audit. Its 48,061-byte receipt has SHA-256 429f353b4e8eba46d726f570456097dae8c4d3edadf22d414d12360e5a9173cb. Current publication is constrained to the existing research checkpoint, with the prior3,782-byte root index retained exactly under a named alias.

## Time, rights and product limits

K remains 2026-10-09T00:00:00Z, and the acquired F is later. Public-by-K is UNPROVED for this vendor capture. A later retrieval and a correctly ordered receipt cannot alone establish an earlier public version or its correction history. These native nanosecond receipts do not relax the structural kernel's explicit UTC precision contract.

Source, owner and reader retain basis_eligible=False, context_only=True, zero proposal weight and all inherited may_* capabilities false. Graph1 and cohort F are null. This witness supplies no complete primary-listing population, issuer/class bridge, outstanding-share basis, D-price/currency, activity classification, complete 42-pool denominator, thirty-case difficult set or comparative-vendor population.

The capture uses an existing permitted source path. It creates no general redistribution, training, public export or product-use license. The current checkpoint contains public/source execution evidence and metadata, not provider rows or private store bodies. No new trust, rights or admission registry is introduced.

## Immediate execution order

Observation candidate964a4b36dddff4e2b01eea4e8e8b2d69dfb4b031 now retains the full preceding CI evidence and accepted-main integration. Natural CI 37962235329 tests a distinct synthetic commit 7b882dadf2f4d5806d23727b558c5b9622ab8538 over base 6f2efb43d88eb65c1d733f684513aaa19d1588a2. Its concluded full evidence and unchanged canonical release gate remain required before ordinary expected-head merge and the retained-C01 accepted-source replay. This preparation does not claim that release has occurred.

After observation acceptance, normally integrate accepted main into this existing kernel branch, preserving the accepted observation job, all other CI jobs and the diagnostic job/curated entry exactly once. The corrected kernel source and its 117-case native pass remain fixed; rerun only checks required by a concrete integration risk. Publish the combined candidate for its own natural hosted proof and ordinary release.

The next empirical source step must address complete historical population and eligibility evidence under the incumbent source/Data OS owners. Another convenience probe alone does not establish that denominator. The accepted implementation masterplan, method quotas and owner boundaries remain in force. Commissioning Sol CEO architectural adjudication, production readiness and predictive usefulness are separate, unasserted decisions.

# NVIDIA source witness: publication guide

This directory preserves the actual public execution evidence for one completed nonempty convenience capture, the unchanged independent public review and the principal's separately recovered launch/process receipts.

- NVDA_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_002.tar.gz and NVDA_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST_002.json contain the native preparer's exact public/source packet. Verify the manifest and every member before extracting; inspect scripts as evidence, and do not execute archived acquisition or application programs.
- INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW_001.md is the complete unchanged 9,031-byte report, SHA-256 870cc8bda77203937519e6fb0a213edad7e15814101a77021a13e63a0558c443.
- principal_addition_003 contains the exact retained launch text and JSON-value process wrappers, its verified Git transport and separate native readback receipt.
- NATIVE_PUBLICATION_PREFLIGHT_005.json records the principal's current branch/source/old-file checks.
- README_BEFORE_NVDA_PUBLICATION_007.md preserves the previous 3,782-byte root index exactly.
- ISSUER_COORDINATES_AND_LIMITS_006.md supplies current primary-source links. It is a new bounded citation note, not a recreated copy of the inaccessible earlier frozen source-case files.

Publication filenames are aliases for copied immutable bytes. The original member names and provenance remain in each archive/manifest. The whole-checkpoint publication manifest lists every newly written path and the prior root-index alias.

The earlier initial preparation and unknown scratch-write effects remain historical. No vendor reacquisition, private-row export, archived test execution, source-registry update or predictive promotion occurs in this publication.

# NVIDIA issuer coordinates and vendor-mapping limit

Primary sources reopened by the principal on2026-10-09 for this publication note. This note is newly authored; it does not replace or reproduce the earlier four-file frozen source-profile package.

| Coordinate | Issuer evidence |
|---|---|
| Announcement | The May 22, 2024 results release announced the ten-for-one common-stock split. |
| Record / planned distribution | That release specified June 6 record holders and distribution after the June 7 market close. |
| Legal effectiveness | The June 7 Form 8-K states that the charter amendment became effective at 4:01 p.m. Eastern on June 7; the filed amendment specifies that coordinate. |
| Expected trading | Both release and 8-K described expected split-adjusted trading from June 10 market open. |
| Subsequent issuer confirmation | The quarter ended July 28 Form 10-Q reports the additional shares' distribution after the June 7 close and retrospective adjustment of share/per-share amounts. |

Sources: [May 22 issuer release](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2024/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2025/); [June 7 Form 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000144/nvda-20240607.htm); [filed charter amendment](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000144/bodapproved-projectsundaex.htm); [July 28 Form 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000264/nvda-20240728.htm), Note 1.

These coordinates support issuer-event investigation. They do not define the vendor's execution-date field, prove its historical correction sequence, or observe the first actual exchange trade. The retained private comparison was deliberately narrower: consistency with a predeclared issuer profile. Its reported boolean does not establish canonical legal-entity/security-class mapping, D-basis share counts, a complete action history, source rights or a K-eligible vendor vintage. Vendor date semantics therefore remain UNRECONCILED and the captured source remains context-only.

Share-action evidence can help investigate equity-basis normalization. It supplies no independent commercial relationship, thematic membership, correlation result or causal economic coefficient.
